additional_info.subject: RE: ID0467734-DC/Si-D/MC-[Y2 / R9 313202799038] OCPP connection issue CRM:03056000797
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The terminal resumed communication without intervention.
However, I created tickets to track offline terminals because I had more than three terminals offline at the same time.
This had never happened before, and I prefer to keep track of the dates and your advice on the subject in case it happens again.
Why is communication active in SCB but not in OCPP?
We have multi-operator SIM cards, so there is no reason why we should not be on the same network as your SIM card.
Thank you for your interest in this matter. If it happens again, I will keep you informed.
Best regards.
Cédric SCHOEPFF
Technicien d'Exploitation Mobilités Electriques

Regarding your question, the OCPP communication was offline, which indicates that the issue is likely related to the network possibly the SIM card, the cable, or the network router.
I also want to clarify that it doesn’t matter that the OCPP and the SCB are in the same charger, as each has a separate SIM and a separate router.
